definitions.explanation: Describes behavior, manner, or presence that makes others feel threatened or pressured into submission through implied power or aggression.

examples.japanese: {威圧的|いあつてき}な{視線|しせん}を{感|かん}じた。
{彼|かれ}の{威圧的|いあつてき}な{雰囲気|ふんいき}に{圧倒|あっとう}された。
examples.english: I was overwhelmed by his intimidating presence.

examples.japanese: {威圧的|いあつてき}な{言動|げんどう}はパワハラに{該当|がいとう}する{可能性|かのうせい}がある。
examples.english: Intimidating words and actions may constitute power harassment.

notes:
Compound of {威圧|いあつ} (coercion, intimidation) + {的|てき} (like). Describes creating a sense of fear or submission in others through one's demeanor, words, or physical presence. Always negative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {威圧的|いあつてき}な{態度|たいど}: intimidating attitude
- {威圧的|いあつてき}な{雰囲気|ふんいき}: intimidating atmosphere
- {威圧的|いあつてき}な{言動|げんどう}: intimidating words and behavior
- {威圧的|いあつてき}な{視線|しせん}: intimidating look/gaze

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {高圧的|こうあつてき}な: overbearing, high-handed (uses authority/position to pressure)
- {脅迫的|きょうはくてき}な: threatening (implies explicit threats)
- {横柄|おうへい}な: arrogant (rude, haughty demeanor)
- {強面|こわもて}の: tough-looking, fierce-faced (about physical appearance)
